seo.metaTitle: Cron expression explainer — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Parse cron schedule expressions into a clear, human-readable description and preview the upcoming execution times. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/cron-parser-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Cron expression explainer processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/cron-parser-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Cron expression explainer upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Cron expression explainer executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/cron-parser-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Cron expression explainer?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/cron_parser.json or open /tools/cron-parser?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
